entities.summary: Elisabeth Lukas is an Austrian psychiatrist and one of the central figures in logotherapy, a branch of psychotherapy founded by Viktor Frankl. She has won multiple awards for her contributions and founded an institute of logotherapy in Germany, training hundreds of logotherapists
